title: Increasing enumeration of an infinite subset of the natural numbers
statement: For every infinite subset $A\subseteq\mathbf N$ [def-sfb-finite-infinite-set], there is a bijection $a:\mathbf N\to A$ that is strictly increasing: for natural numbers $m<n$, the underlying natural numbers satisfy $a(m)<a(n)$. The subset $A$ has the order induced from $\mathbf N$.
